entities.name: William Löfqvist
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sven William "Wille" Löfqvist was a Swedish ice hockey goaltender who played for the Swedish national team. He was part of the Swedish team earning a bronze medal at the 1980 Winter Olympics in Lake Placid, New York, United States. He later became a professional golfer and played on the Swedish Golf Tour.
